==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson and I went to the Elven Village skatepark. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The Elven Village Skatepark resembles a skatepark made up of ramps and rails made of wood and white stone.)
Johnson had no experience skateboarding, so I was afraid he might get hurt.
I taught Johnson how to use his Lucid Light to ollie, grind, and kickflip with ease. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
